FLUORESCENT – London’s Latest Perfume Salon

Products – Perfume Range

Vanilla Twirl – With a healthy dose of wild orchid vanilla, vanilla sees consistent sales all year round – is not limited to seasons.

London Rose – Our most popular perfume. Containing rose petals individually picked by our expert florists. Sold all year round, though the majority of those sales are made in Spring and Autumn.

Summer Berry – With a sweet, strawberry scent, Summer Berry is an exclusive, only sold during the summer periods.

All perfumes are sold at a base price of £80.

Products – Scented Candles Range

While are candles are designed on the seasons, they are sold all year round – though each candle receives its promotional spotlight during its season. All candles are 50ml in size. Scented candle sales make up 30% of our total South Kensington turnover from both candles and perfumes.

White Winter – A white marble coloured candle. Hints of cinnamon.

Red Autumn – A fire red coloured candle.  Strong smells of wood embers and molasses.

Green Spring – A leaf green coloured candle. Fruity overtones and fresh lavender notes.

Yellow Summer – A calm yellow coloured candle. Honey scents with citrus tones.

The scented candle premium pack ‘Seasons’ includes all 4 candle products.

All candles are sold at a base price of £25.

Markets & Demographics

Our market is the modern women, young adult to elderly. Our branches receive customers from all parts of the world eager to wear our perfumes and smell our candles. Guided by our typical monthly sales, particular products are most popular amongst different demographics. Giving the demographics of our global customer base, marketing focuses on what products are popular with what demographics.

European customers:  Vanilla Twirl, Red Autumn and Green Spring

Middle Eastern:  London Rose.

Eastern Asian:  Summery Berry and Yellow Summer

North American:  London Rose and Yellow Summer

South American:  Vanilla Twirl, London Rose, Red Autumn, and White Winter

African:  London Rose, Summer Berry, and Red Autumn.

Packaging:

The way we present our products is important for branding and thus our market strategy. We have three packaging variation for each product:

None: Clean white packaging (no extra cost).

Premium Pack: Red packaging with ribbon (extra £1.50)

Gift Box: Reusable cushioned box, extra (£6.00)

Sustainability Declaration - Made from a combination of custom mould fibres, water and pulp, the packaging consists of entirely bio-degradable material. It is 100% recyclable.

Strategy - Growth

European expansion:  Given the global recognition of London, its brand extends beyond that of just London based tourism or locals. We have opened a Dublin based branch of Fluorescent and are looking to open in Copenhagen. We are currently developing a new exclusive perfume product for our Dublin branch: Flower.  There is no intention to locate ourselves outside of Europe given our research the profits will not be worth the investment.

London market growth:  Our South Kensington branch took an annual turnover of £400,000. While we are a relatively new and smaller brand compared to some competitors, we have established a baseline from which to enact growth. We will expand the product range starting with a new perfume. Already we have designed premium packs; we look to extend these ranges and options for the consumer.

Strategy - Branding

Branding:  Capitalising on the global, modern yet vintage, romantic ideal of ‘London’.  However, in our international branches, we will brand our products on its occupying city. Encapsulated in this idea, presented through the symbol of the flower. Emphasis on the seasons with attention to the foliage and colour of each season. Sophisticated. Flowery scents. No oud scents.

Pricing: Market research suggests that customers prefer more expensive items than less expensive. Even if the product is the same, price is synonymous with quality for consumers. Given that our pricing strategy aims for the middle market, we will lose some potential big sales due to the lack of the highly expensive product. Therefore, our new perfume Flower is being designed as a highly expensive luxury item.

Executive Team

Aishah Horner – Director of Fluorescent. Aishah has been working in perfumery for over twelve years. Involved in every stage of the process from selecting ingredients of the products to branding to business communications.

Raheel Houghton – Head of Marketing and Sales. Raheel is a certified economics who has her finger on the pulse of change. She makes sure the products are presented in the best way for the target markets.

Saxon Irwin – Head of Management. Saxon manages our London branch and all the staff, as well as proxy guiding of our sister branches at Dublin and soon to be Copenhagen.

Dr Patrick Tall – Head of Products. Patrick designs all of our products, with input from Aishah, ensures the highest quality and standards for each product. All ingredients are economical as well as ecologically friendly.

questions.t: According to Fluorescent’s demographic data, their most consistently popular product is London Rose.
questions.e: True - In the Markets and Demographics section, we can see that from the popular products in each demographic, London Rose appears a total of four times, greater than any other product. Therefore, it is demonstrably their most consistently popular product. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Candles sold in the ‘Seasons’ premium pack are each 60ml in size.
questions.e: False - In the Product - Candle range section, it states that all candles are 50ml in size. Though all candles are included in the 'Seasons' pack, there is no mention that their sizes change at all. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: European customers purchase more Red Autumn candles than South American customers.
questions.e: Cannot Say - While both European and South American customers find Red Autumn candles favourable, there is no indication of the sales differences between the two. We do not have enough information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: A White Winter candle sold in a gift box would cost a customer £30.00.
questions.e: False - In the Products - Scented Candles Range tab, it states that the price of a candle is £25. It also states that one of the candles is White Winter. In the Packaging tab, there is a list of gift options. The Gift Box is an extra £6.00. This totals a White Winter in a gift box as £31.00, not £30.00. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: The packaging for Fluorescent’s scented candles can be recycled.
questions.e: True - In the Packaging tab, in the sustainability declaration, it states that the packaging is 100%. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: In setting up a Paris branch, the Director will rely on Saxon Irwin.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Executive Team tab, though Saxon Irwin is head of management and manages the London branch staff and guides sister branches, there is no guarantee nor demonstrable evidence that Saxon would be relied upon by the Director, Aishah Horner. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Fluorescent’s perfume range were designed solely by Dr Patrick Tall.
questions.e: False - In the Executive Team tab, it states that while Dr Patrick Tall designs all the products, Aishah Horner is involved in selecting the ingredients and helps with the process. Therefore, Dr Patrick Tall does not solely design all of the products. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: The proposed name for the new perfume product in Dublin is Cherry.
questions.e: False - In the Strategy - Branding tab, it states the the new perfume product is called Flower; therefore, not Cherry. Thus the correct answer is False.

questions.t: The Dublin branch of Fluorescent will brand itself on the romantic ideal of ‘London’.
questions.e: False – In the Strategy - Branding tab, it states that in the international branches, of which Dublin is one, the branding will be based on its occupying city. Therefore, not London. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Fluorescent products do not use oud scents.
questions.e: True – In the Strategy - Branding tab, it states that the scents are flowery, no oud scents. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: London Rose perfume does not contain rose petals.
questions.e: True - In the Products - Perfume Range tab, is states that London Rose contain 'rose petals individually picked'. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: North American customers purchase more candle than perfume products.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Markets and Demographics tab, it states that North American customers like most the London Rose and Yellow Summer. A perfume and a candle. Given that state of affairs, we cannot properly ascertain which more they have purchased more of. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: London Rose perfume purchased in the premium packaging would cost £81.50.
questions.e: True - In the Products - Perfume tab, it states that the price of all perfumes is £80. In the Packaging tab, it states that the premium pack costs £1.50. Therefore, together it would cost £81.50. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: The London branch only has one store based in South Kensington.
questions.e: Cannot Say – In the Strategy - Growth tab it mentions the branch in South Kensington and does not mention any other branch. But the mere mention of it being the South Kensington branch potentially suggests that there is other. Either way, there is not enough information to know the validity of the statement for it is not stated demonstrably true or false. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Scented candles at the South Kensington branch account for £120,000 turnover.
questions.n: Casemate correction: AssessmentDay's printed answer for this question is Cannot Say, but its own working shows the statement is exactly supported (30% of £400,000 = £120,000), so the answer here is True.
questions.e: Cannot Say – In the Strategy - Growth tab, it states that the South Kensington branch took an annual turnover of £400,000. In the Products - Scented Candle Range tab it states that candles sales make up 30% of the total South Kensington turnover. 400,000 / 100 * 30 = £120,000. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Fluorescent intend to expand their business into a new location in Asia.
questions.e: False - In the Strategy - Growth tab, it states that 'there is no intention to locate ourselves outside of Europe given our research the profits will not be worth the investment.' A demonstrable indication that the statement is false. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Raheel Houghton deals with marketing of products with help from Aishah Horner.
questions.e: True - In the Executive Team tab, it states that Raheel Houghton, who is Head of Marketing and Sales, deals with marketing. Aishah Horner helps with all aspects. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: If the ‘Seasons’ pack was 20% cheaper than buying all of its products individually, it would cost £75.
questions.e: False – In the Products - Scented Candles Range tab, it states that a candle is worth £25. Therefore, buying all 4 individually would cost £100. If the 'Seasons' pack, which is all 4 candles, was 20% cheaper it would cost £80, not £75. Thus the correct answer is false. .

questions.t: Green Spring is the least popular scented candle product from Fluorescent.
questions.e: Cannot Say - There is no indication of sales by product other than popularity by demographics. However, even this gives no figures regarding. Therefore, we have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Red Autumn candle is the same broad colour as the Premium pack.
questions.e: True - In the Packaging tab, it states that the premium pack is red. The Red Autumn candle, as given by its title, is also red, and by its description as fire red. These are both red, and so fall broadly under the same colour. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: According to the monthly sales, the South American customers have the most particular purchasing.
questions.e: False - In the Markets and Demographics tab, we can see that the Middle Eastern customers like the London Rose particularly, not anything else. This means that they are very particular. Whereas the South American customers have 4 different products as the most popular, meaning they are by definition less particular than the Middle Eastern customers. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: The Head of Products has a doctorate qualification.
questions.e: True - In the Executive Team tab, it states the head of products, is called Dr Patrick Tall, with her title indicative of having a doctorate qualification. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: According to the branding strategy, each candle should represent a season.
questions.e: True - In the Strategy - Branding tab, it states that there is an emphasis on the seasons. And in the Products - Candle range, each candle is named after one of the four seasons: Summer, Spring, Winter and Autumn. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: According to the product range, there is a limited selection for customers to choose from.
questions.e: Cannot Say - There are 3 perfumes, and 4 candles, there is no indication from the information that this product range is somehow limited. While it is still expanding, which could suggest that it has not yet reached its full potential, there is no mention that it is limited or not. Therefore, we have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: If London Rose sold 50% of all perfume sales, they alone made more than £150,000 turnover at the South Kensington branch.
questions.e: False - In the Strategy - Growth tab, it states that the South Kensington branch made an annual £400,000 turnover. Therefore, 50% would be £200,000, regardless of what perfume product made that money. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: According to the monthly sales, the honey scent candle is popular with the European demographic.
questions.e: False - In the Products - Scented Candles tab, it states that the honey scented candle is Yellow Summer. In the Markets and Demographics tab, the European customers are interested in Vanilla Twirl, Red Autumn and Green Spring - not Yellow Summer. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Fluorescent’s new product will contain sugar beets.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Growth tab, it mentions the new product, Flower, but does not mention what it will contain. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: After Dublin, Fluorescent intend to build many different branches across Europe.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Growth tab it states that after the Dublin branch, a branch is going to be built in Copenhagen. This shows that an expansion of the business abroad has been planned and naturally we might assume that this will be repeated, but we aren't given any further information to confirm this is the case. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: According to the monthly sales, the molasses scented candle is popular with the African demographic.
questions.e: True – In the Products - Scented Candles tab, it states that the molasses scented candle is Red Autumn. In the Markets and Demographics tab, the African customers are interested in London Rose, Summer Berry, and Red Autumn. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Ingredients used in the Perfume range are ecologically friendly.
questions.e: True - In the Executive Team tab, it states that all ingredients in the products are 'economical as well as ecologically friendly'. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Young adult women purchase more Fluorescent perfume than elderly women.
questions.e: Cannot Say - There is no indication that young adult women purchase more Fluorescent perfume than elderly women as the data is not present. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Vanilla Twirl accounted for 20% of the annual turnover for the South Kensington branch.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Growth tab, it states that the South Kensington branch made an annual £400,000 turnover. However, there is no indication of what products made up this figure asides the perfume 30%. This is still not broken down by product. There is insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: The lavender scented candle is the same colour as the no cost packaging.
questions.e: False - In the Products - Scented Candles tab, it states that the lavender scented candle is the Green Spring. In the Packaging tab, it states that no cost packaging is clean white. Therefore, they are not the same colours. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: During the Winter, the cinnamon scented candle will be promoted.
questions.e: True - In the Products - Candle tab, it states that the cinnamon scented candle is the White Winter candle, hence it is the winter candle. It also states that each candle will receive its 'promotional spotlight during its season'. Therefore, they match. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: During the Autumn period, the Summer Berry is sold.
questions.e: False - In the Products - Perfume tab, it states the Summer Berry is an exclusively summer period perfume. That means that it is not sold during the Autumn period. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: During the Spring period, the Green Spring outsold the Red Autumn.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Products - Candles tab, it states that the candles are sold all year round and that they account for 30% turnover. However, there is no indication of what products sells how much. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Aishah Horner has been working in perfumery for more than a decade.
questions.e: True - In the Executive Team tab, it states that Aishah Horner has been working in perfumery for over a decade. Therefore, more than 10 years. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Raheel Houghton earns a higher salary than Saxon Irwin.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Executive Team tab, it does not states enough about salary. We therefore have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.
